note: 14 wooded mountaintop acres ~10 min south of Brevard; a few shady, graveled RV sites among walk-to tent sites, camping shelters and cabins. Hills and curves on the mountaintop: pull-behind trailers only to 28 ft. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $45 (ResNexus quote for April 2027) and 30-amp electric; added water/no sewer, max 32 ft for a motorhome with a pull-through, bathhouse/dump/potable water/laundry/store/Wi-Fi, open year-round, ResNexus booking. Note cleaned of amenities and hookups. Not stated: RV site count.
flags: Steep mountain access: 'When towing a trailer longer than 25ft. in the mountains, a 4-wheel drive vehicle is HIGHLY recommended--mountain roads' steep hills and curves can be slippery when wet' (https://www.ash-grove.com/Campsites/RV-and-tent-site-information-and-site-map). The recommendation is for towed trailers over 25 ft, not motorhomes; EKKO (23 ft) is within the 32-ft motorhome limit, but the hills are why the limits are short.
